title: libs/backend-common/src/database hotspot (213 pts) — schema-manager + index barrel churn
rule_violated: Anti-pattern: omnibus barrel file (libs/backend-common/src/index.ts) that re-exports everything; every add triggers a wide invalidation.
notes: Tier 2 fix: split barrels — database/index.ts, auth/index.ts etc., consumers import specific subtree. Move schema-manager logic into migration-runner (already owns schema semantics).
